title: US and UK launch joint airstrikes on Houthi military positions in Yemen
snippet: American and British fighter jets carried out targeted airstrikes against Houthi radar and missile sites across western Yemen overnight.

title: Yemen: US and British forces strike Houthi missile and radar sites
snippet: Joint military strikes hit several Houthi positions in Sanaa and coastal provinces following attacks on Red Sea shipping.

title: Ukrainian drone strikes set ablaze oil depot in Russia's Rostov region
snippet: A long-range Ukrainian drone attack struck a fuel depot in Rostov, triggering a massive industrial blaze according to regional authorities.

title: Cross-border shelling damages power substation in Belgorod
snippet: Artillery shelling in the Russian border city of Belgorod caused local electrical outages on Thursday morning.

title: UK Ministry of Defence signs £400m contract for air defence missiles
snippet: The British MoD announced a procurement contract for next-generation short-range air defence systems to boost Army readiness.

title: Rebels claim downing of military transport aircraft; army denies loss
snippet: Insurgent commanders claimed they shot down an Antonov transport plane, but military spokesmen denied the report as unconfirmed propaganda.

title: Premier League match postponed after drone strike near stadium
snippet: The football clash between Arsenal and Chelsea was delayed following an isolated security incident in the city centre.

title: Hollywood box office hits record high over holiday weekend
snippet: Celebrities gathered for red carpet premieres as movie ticket sales surged.
